note: Each verdict has a short form for chips and tables, and the archive's own full wording for the body of a card. The short form is a label; the full form is what was actually written down, and is what the site quotes when there is room for it. Stimulus names (struck, struck_vibrato, …) are identifiers and are not translated in any locale — the archive's own description of what each one sees is shown beside them instead.
